# mypy_boto3_builder: repairing scattered regressions without a test suite

This tool takes a cloud provider's published API definitions and emits typed interface bundles for them, and it now gets things wrong from the moment I start it through to the documentation it leaves behind. Nothing about the upstream definitions changed and nothing about how I invoke it changed. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I could pin down by exercising it from the outside.

It goes wrong before it has looked at a single definition. Starting it from a terminal with its usual defaults finishes without producing anything: the step that actually builds a product is never reached, so nothing appears and no error explains why. Asking for results somewhere given relative to where I am standing no longer pins that location down — the text is kept exactly as I typed it, so where things land depends on where I happened to be. Asking it to list what sits under a folder gives back nothing whatsoever when I name no exclusions, and when I do exclude one entry that excluded entry is the only thing I get. Asking which upstream APIs changed in a given release of the SDK library underneath answers with an empty list every time, and when the fetch of the release notes answers 404 the failure is swallowed quietly instead of surfacing as a build error.
